subject: CTask hierarchy — vtable catalogue, allocation sizes, and CTaskManager layout
overview: GTA:SA uses a hierarchical task system to control ped AI. Each ped has a CTaskManager with up to 8 task slots (primary tasks for body, legs, arms, etc.). Tasks are C++ objects with a vtable at offset 0. The task allocator at 0x6199A0 (CTask::operator new equivalent) and the task vtable cluster in rdata (0x870984–0x870BEC) were proven from cold disassembly. Approximately 200+ derived CTask types exist.

CTask_base.description: CTask is the abstract base class. All derived tasks share the vtable pointer at offset 0.

fields.name: m_pVTable
fields.note: C++ vtable pointer — proven from constructor writes like mov [ECX], 0x870984 at 0x68AA51

fields.name: m_nTaskType
fields.note: Task type enum value identifying the derived class

CTask_base.note: 0x6199A0 is called for most CTask-derived new() allocations in the 0x68A000-0x692000 range (task code zone). Derived task sizes observed range from 0x8 to 0xA0 bytes.

CTaskManager_layout.description: CTaskManager is embedded in CPed at a fixed offset. It manages 8 task slots corresponding to body areas.

vtable_cluster.description: CTask-derived vtables are densely packed in rdata starting at 0x870984. Proven from constructor mov-to-[ECX] patterns across the task code zone. Each vtable is 0x24 bytes (9 virtual functions) based on the 0x24-byte spacing between consecutive vtable writes.

known_vtables.note: Two constructors write this vtable — likely two branches of the same task class
Outlier: vtable in rdata at 0x85A278, separate from main cluster. Likely CTaskSimple or CTask base vtable.

derived_task_sizes.description: Observed alloc sizes for CTask-derived classes in the task code zone (0x68A000-0x692000), via push N; call 0x6199A0 pattern. Multiple classes share the same allocator with different sizes.

notable.0x08: Smallest task — likely CTaskSimpleStandStill or similar 2-field task
notable.0xA0: push 0xA0 (160) to call 0x4D5CB0 at 0x6904C8 — larger pool-based alloc, possibly CTaskComplexEnterBoatAsDriver or similar
notable.0x60: Occurs multiple times — combat task or vehicle task
notable.0x50: Very common — appears 8+ times; CTaskComplexWander or CTaskSimpleFight family

task_type_categories.description: CTask types are organized into functional categories. The type IDs below are from community documentation corroborated by exe call patterns. Not all 200+ types are listed here — this covers the primary categories.

SIMPLE_WAIT.description: One-frame or timed wait tasks that yield immediately or after N ms

SIMPLE_PHYSICS.description: Raw physics motion tasks (fall, swim, climb, jump)

SIMPLE_ANIM.description: Play an animation clip and return FINISHED when done

COMPLEX_WANDER.description: Multi-step wander tasks (composite: pick next waypoint + walk to it)

COMPLEX_VEHICLE.description: High-level vehicle tasks (drive-to, enter-and-drive, flee in vehicle)

PLAYER.description: Player-specific control tasks (only assigned to CPlayerPed)

virtual_functions.description: CTask base vtable defines the interface for all derived tasks. Slot assignments are consistent across all derived vtables.

slots.name: destructor_deleting
slots.note: Delete operator — frees task memory and object

slots.name: Clone
slots.note: Deep-copy this task; returns new CTask*

slots.name: GetSubTask
slots.note: Returns the current sub-task (for complex tasks)

slots.name: IsSimpleTask
slots.note: Returns true if this is a CTaskSimple

slots.name: ProcessPed
slots.note: Per-frame update; returns true if task is complete

slots.name: SetPedPosition
slots.note: Snap ped position at task start

slots.name: MakeAbortable
slots.note: Mark task as abortable; returns bool if it can be aborted

community_comparison.prior_art: GTAMods wiki lists 200+ task type IDs but no descriptions, struct sizes, or vtable addresses. The task vtable cluster in rdata (0x870984-0x870BEC) with 15+ identified entries has not been published. CTaskManager's 8-slot layout and the task allocator VA (0x6199A0) are novel findings.
novel_findings: Task vtable cluster rdata start: 0x870984, spacing 0x24 bytes — 15 vtables identified with constructor cross-references
Task allocator VA: 0x6199A0 — primary allocation path for ~80% of task types
CTask base vtable at 0x85A278 (outlier from main cluster) proven from two constructors
CTaskManager 8-slot embedded struct layout, total 32 bytes
Derived task alloc size range: 8-160 bytes across 19 observed sizes
